questions.question: What is the term used to describe the starting chemicals that undergo change in a chemical reaction?
In a chemical reaction, what do we call the newly created substances that are formed?
If we compare the reactants and products in a closed chemical reaction, what can be said about their atoms?
options: The products contain entirely new atoms that were created during the reaction.
The products contain fewer atoms because some are destroyed by heat.
The products and reactants contain exactly the same atoms.
The products contain more atoms than the reactants.

questions.question: How did John Dalton describe the model of an atom?
options: A solid sphere that cannot be broken up.
A cloud of negative charge with a positive center.
A sphere of positive charge with embedded electrons.
A hollow shell containing smaller orbiting particles.

questions.question: Which of the following describes an element?
options: A substance made up of only one type of atom.
A mixture of different types of molecules.
A substance made of different atoms chemically bonded together.
A liquid containing dissolved metal ions.

questions.question: In the chemical formula H₂O, what does the subscript number 2 represent?
options: The number of hydrogen atoms in the compound.
The number of oxygen atoms in the compound.
The chemical state of the compound.

questions.question: Carbon monoxide (CO) and carbon dioxide (CO₂) both contain carbon and oxygen. What is the difference between them?
options: They contain the same elements, but in a different ratio.
One is an element and the other is a mixture.
They have identical physical and chemical properties.

questions.question: What is a key characteristic of metalloid elements?
options: They behave exactly like gases at room temperature.
They are highly reactive liquid metals.
They have some properties of metals and some properties of non-metals.
They only consist of diatomic molecules.

questions.question: Sodium is a highly reactive metal and chlorine is a toxic gas. When they react, they form sodium chloride (table salt). What does this demonstrate?
options: A compound has the exact same properties as its constituent elements.
A compound may have different properties to each of the elements that it is made from.
Chemical reactions only change the physical state of elements.
Sodium chloride remains highly toxic and explosive.

questions.question: Which non-metal is an exception to the general rule and is a good electrical and thermal conductor?
Where are metals generally located on the periodic table?
options: On the left side and in the middle.

questions.question: Oxygen (O₂) and nitrogen (N₂) are gases. What term describes molecules that contain exactly two atoms?
Which group of elements is monatomic and found in the right-hand column of the periodic table?
What name is given to compounds containing metal atoms bonded to a -CO₃ group?
If a compound consists of metal atoms chemically bonded to a -SO₄ group, what is it called?
